title: Dhiiga Jalqabaa Inaaffaadhaan Dhangala'e
intro: Mee bara jalqabaa dhala namaa, yeroo addunyaan guutuun maatii tokko ture mee yaadi. Aarsaan lama Rabbiin duratti yeroo kaa’amu ilaalta — tokko fudhatama, inni kaan immoo dide. Inaaffaan onnee keessatti hidda gadi fageeffata, doorsisni immoo aariidhaan hasaasama. Wanti itti aanu seenaa irratti bara baraan mallattoo ni dhiisa, simbirroon xiqqoo illee barsiisaa taati.
clues: Ani maatii lafarratti isa jalqabaa keessaa tokkodha.
Aarsaa tokko Rabbiif dhiheesse, garuu kan koo hin qeebalamne osoo aarsaan inni kaan hin fudhatamne.
Inaaffaadhaan dubbadhee lubbuu namaa balleessuuf doorsise.
Lafa irratti ajjeechaa haqa hin qabne isa jalqabaa nan raawwadhe.
Akkaataa reeffa dhoksu natti agarsiisuuf kormaan lafa xuuxuu arge.
Gaabbiin guutamee hafee waan harki koo godheef warra mo’aman keessaa tokko ta’e.

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Ajjeechaa obboleessa tokko inaaffaa irraa kan ka'e erga aarsaa dide booda

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
